metadata.description: A curated collection of Claude Code skills for productivity, design, document handling, and developer workflows.

plugins.name: document-skills
plugins.description: Document processing suite: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and PDF

plugins.name: design-skills
plugins.description: Frontend design, algorithmic art, canvas design, brand guidelines, and theme styling

plugins.name: developer-workflow-skills
plugins.description: PR creation, release pipelines, deploy checks, Git-based work reports, testing workflows, Docker analysis, MCP building, prompt optimization, and debugging retrospectives

plugins.name: fde-estimation-skills
plugins.description: Interactive FDE customer-outcome capture, field discovery, reviewed staffing and rate evidence, scope reconciliation, and estimate generation

plugins.name: writing-skills
plugins.description: Documentation co-authoring, internal communications, system prompts, Korean AI-text humanizing, work-summary decoding, and skill creation guides

plugins.name: resume-skills
plugins.description: Resume formatting, translation, and project summary generation

plugins.name: config-skills
plugins.description: Claude config migration and update notes

plugins.name: llm-wiki-skills
plugins.description: LLM-Wiki raw capture and wikification workflows for Obsidian

plugins.name: houmy-skills
plugins.description: Houm: brand and UI design system, operational-document typography, cohort metrics, and codebase refactoring

plugins.name: notion-workspace-skills
plugins.description: Notion workspace dashboards with root-owned databases, safe migrations, timelines, boards, approvals, and role-aware views

plugins.name: claude-api
plugins.description: Claude API and SDK documentation skill for building LLM-powered applications

plugins.name: analysis-skills
plugins.description: Critical thinking, evidence-backed decision reports, business scenario analysis, and health statistics evidence reports

plugins.name: translation-skills
plugins.description: Book translation using parallel sub-agents with multi-format output (HTML, DOCX, EPUB, PDF)

plugins.name: research-workflow-skills
plugins.description: Research workflows: autonomous experiment iteration (keep/discard loop with noise guard and audit trail)

plugins.name: academy-guide
plugins.description: Recommends relevant Claude Academy courses, tutorials, and use cases when users ask how to use Claude

plugins.name: discernment-nudge
plugins.description: Appends two or three short follow-up questions after a substantive answer to help users check key facts, probe the reasoning, and notice missing context
